izzyondroid:org.joinmastodon.android.name: Mastodon
izzyondroid:org.joinmastodon.android.description:
Mastodon is the best way to keep up with what’s happening. Follow anyone across the fediverse and see it all in chronological order. No algorithms, ads, or clickbait in sight.
 This is the official Android app for Mastodon. It is blazing fast and stunningly beautiful, designed to be not just powerful but also easy to use. In our app, you can:
 EXPLORE
 ■ Discover new writers, journalists, artists, photographers, scientists and more ■ See what’s happening in the world
 READ
 ■ Keep up with people you care about in a chronological feed with no interruptions ■ Follow hashtags to keep up with specific topics in real time
 CREATE
 ■ Post to your followers or the whole world, with polls, high quality images and videos ■ Participate in interesting conversations with other people
 CURATE
 ■ Create lists of people to never miss a post ■ Filter words or phrases to control what you do and don’t want to see
 AND MORE!
 ■ A beautiful theme that adapts to your personalized color scheme, light or dark ■ Share and scan QR codes to quickly exchange Mastodon profiles with others ■ Login and switch between multiple accounts ■ Get notified when a specific person posts with the bell button ■ No spoilers! You can put your posts behind content warnings
 A POWERFUL PUBLISHING PLATFORM
 You no longer have to try and appease an opaque algorithm that decides if your friends are going to see what you posted. If they follow you, they’ll see it.
 If you publish it to the open web, it’s accessible on the open web. You can safely share links to Mastodon in the knowledge that anyone will be able to read them without logging in.
 Between threads, polls, high quality images, videos, audio, and content warnings, Mastodon offers plenty of ways to express yourself in a way that suits you.
 A POWERFUL READING PLATFORM
 We don’t need to show you ads, so we don’t need to keep you in our app. Mastodon has the richest selection of 3rd party apps and integrations so you can choose the experience that fits you best.
 Thanks to the chronological home feed, it’s easy to tell when you’ve caught up on all updates and can move on to something else.
 No need to worry that a misclick will ruin your recommendations forever. We don’t guess what you want to see, we let you control it.
 PROTOCOLS, NOT PLATFORMS
 Mastodon is not like a traditional social media platform, but is built on a decentralized protocol. You can sign up on our official server, or choose a 3rd party to host your data and moderate your experience.
 Thanks to the common protocol, no matter what you choose, you can communicate seamlessly with people on other Mastodon servers. But there’s more: With just one account, you can communicate with people from other fediverse platforms.
 Not happy with your choice? You can always switch to a different Mastodon server while taking your followers with you. For advanced users, you can even host your data on your own infrastructure, since Mastodon is open-source.
 NON-PROFIT IN NATURE
 Mastodon is a registered non-profit in the US and Germany. We are not motivated by extracting monetary value from the platform, but by what’s best for the platform.
 AS FEATURED IN: TIME, Forbes, Wired, The Guardian, CNN, The Verge, TechCrunch, Financial Times, Gizmodo, PCMAG.com, and more.

fdroid:org.webgpt.app.description:
Why WebGPT?
• WebGPT is not a simple WebView wrapper, it offers many extra enhancements for a better mobile experience, such as a flexible WebView switcher, seamless Android sharing integration, and improved handling of downloads and external links.
Features
Main Features
• Smooth loading screen. A spinning logo that fades out with no white flash. An optional page-progress bar can be turned on in Settings.
• Privacy. Third-party cookies are blocked on the main page. Sign-in popups keep them, so Google sign-in still works. Camera and microphone permissions are requested only when the site asks for them.
• Links open where they should. Links to other sites open in your default browser.
• Downloads. Generated files, PDFs, Word documents and Markdown exports to your Download folder.
• Long-press an image to share it or save it.
• Settings menu. There is a hidden settings menu under Android Settings → Apps → WebGPT and tap the gear icon. There you can pick a WebView, show the page-progress bar and check for updates.
Sharing
• Share to WebGPT from any app. Shared text is copied to the clipboard and shared files are attached to the chat for you.
• Ask WebGPT appears in the text-selection menu and copies the selected text to the clipboard.
WebView switcher
• Choose between 13 WebView providers: Android System WebView, Chrome (stable, beta, dev, canary), Thorium, Mulch, Huawei WebView and Amazon WebView.
• A built-in downloader tab links to Google Play, Thorium (GitHub) and Mulch (GitLab).
• If the app crashes 3 times in a row, it sends you to Settings so you can pick another WebView.
• An optional "Optimize WebView performance" switch can improve speed on some devices.
Known limitations
• Voice dictation may refuse to start even with permissions granted. Switching to another WebView can fix it.
• Google sign-in is sometimes blocked by Google in Android WebViews ("browser or app may not be secure"). Email sign-in works, and trying another WebView can help.

flathub:com.one_ware.OneWare.description:
OneWare Studio is the next generation IDE for electronics development. It supports a broad range
 of development languages including VHDL, Verilog, C++, and more. It is designed to streamline electronics
 development with features like a high-speed simulation viewer and advanced debugging tools. OneWare
 Studio also offers extensive customization with an extensible architecture for custom tools and
 strong support for digital twin technology, making it ideal for firmware and hardware development
 across diverse applications.
 These are a few of the current features:
 Comprehensive support for VHDL and Verilog for streamlined digital design
 Vendor-independent support for FPGA development
 Support for simulation tools like GHDL or IVerilog with a integrated high-speed, multithreaded
 VCD Viewer

 extensions

flathub:com.rawtherapee.RawTherapee.name: RawTherapee
flathub:com.rawtherapee.RawTherapee.summary: An advanced raw photo development program
flathub:com.rawtherapee.RawTherapee.description:
RawTherapee is a powerful, cross-platform raw photo processing program. It is written mostly in C++ using a GTK+ front-end. It uses a patched version of dcraw for reading raw files, with an in-house solution which adds the highest quality support for certain camera models unsupported by dcraw and enhances the accuracy of certain raw files already supported by dcraw. It is notable for the advanced control it gives the user over the demosaicing and development process.
 RawTherapee is designed for developing raw files from a broad range of digital cameras, as well as HDR DNG files and non-raw image formats (JPEG, TIFF and PNG). The target audience ranges from enthusiast newcomers who wish to broaden their understanding of how digital imaging works to semi-professional photographers. Knowledge in color science is not compulsory, but it is recommended that you are eager to learn and ready to read our documentation (RawPedia) as well as look up basic concepts which lie outside the scope of RawPedia, such as color balance, elsewhere.
 Of course, professionals may use RawTherapee too while enjoying complete freedom, but will probably lack some peripheral features such as Digital Asset Management, printing, uploading, etc. RawTherapee is not aimed at being an inclusive all-in-one program, and the open-source community is sufficiently developed by now to offer all those peripheral features in other specialized software.

It doesn't support the KeyStep / BeatStep Pro sequencer banks, BeatStep Pro presets and the DrumBrute/MiniBrute banks yet.
It only supports the global controls from KeyLab 25 / 49 / 61 / 88 and SparkLE / The Laboratory.
If you think some untested devices work well, please let us know.
If not, let us know as well.

flathub:mobi.snowball.Snowball.name: Snowball
flathub:mobi.snowball.Snowball.description:
Roll around collecting snow and avoiding trees until your snowball is large enough to continue to the next level.
 The snowball turns green when the next level portals have opened, the portals are located at the north and south poles of the sphere.
 The larger the snowballs you collect higher the score. Gold snow is double the reward of white.
 Picking up snow increases your speed temporarily; the idea is to enter a flow of collecting snow so that your speed stays up.
 Try not to hit the trees as they will slow you down and reduce the mass of your snowball unless your snowball is large enough to consume them. Trees will shrink slightly as you approach them to show that they can be "consumed" aka rolled over without a penalty to snowball size, only speed.
 The goal? If you need one: complete each level or a sequence of levels with the highest score in the shortest time. I just play it to get lost in a trance and typically play 10 minute long games.
 The "any key" on your keyboard will open the menu, and all the other controls are bound to the mouse:
 Left click to toggle mouse focus, scroll and right click for zoom, X1 and X2 or Mouse 4 and 5 will increment or decrement the mouse sensitivity.
 A web version is available at snowball.mobi

flathub:org.freecad.FreeCAD.name: FreeCAD
flathub:org.freecad.FreeCAD.summary: An open source parametric 3D CAD modeler
flathub:org.freecad.FreeCAD.description:
FreeCAD is an open-source parametric 3D modeler built to help you design real-world objects
 of any size. With parametric modeling, you can easily modify your designs by adjusting parameters
 in the model history. FreeCAD is suitable for a wide range of uses, from product design and mechanical
 engineering to architecture and 3D printing.
 The software allows you to create constrained 2D sketches, which can be used as the basis for
 more complex 3D models. It includes tools to adjust dimensions, extract design details, and produce
 production-ready technical drawings. FreeCAD is available on Windows, Mac, and Linux, and supports
 various file formats like STEP, IGES, STL, SVG, DXF, OBJ, IFC, and more, making it easy to fit
 into existing workflows. It also supports customization through Python scripting for those who
 want to automate tasks or develop custom features.
 FreeCAD offers several specialized workbenches, including tools for Finite Element Analysis
 (FEA), Building Information Modeling (BIM), CAM / CNC and robot movement simulation. You can expand
 its capabilities with add-ons, plugins, and macros created by the FreeCAD community, which can
 be installed directly from the application. This flexibility makes it a practical choice for both
 professionals and hobbyists.

flathub:org.syntalos.syntalos.name: Syntalos
flathub:org.syntalos.syntalos.summary: Synchronized data acquisition from diverse sources and flexible experiment control
flathub:org.syntalos.syntalos.description:
Syntalos is a software for timestamp-synchronized parallel data acquisition from diverse data sources
 and for closed-loop interventions.
 Among many other things, Syntalos supports:
 Intan RHD/RHS systems, Open Ephys acquisition boards, and Neuropixels probes via remote SpikeGLX
 UCLA Miniscopes for calcium imaging in freely moving animals
 Many industrial and generic cameras
 Microcontrollers and I/O boards via Firmata or MicroPython
 Online signal and video processing
 The modularity of Syntalos allows it to be used for a wide variety of experiments, and it often can be used
 without any programming skills. Data sources, sinks, and processing blocks can be connected graphically with
 virtual "wires" to form a data flow graph using drag & drop, to represent how data should be acquired,
 displayed, or stored.
 If more flexibility is needed, Syntalos can be extended with Python scripts, live-programmed microcontrollers,
 or custom modules written in Python or C++.
 For all data sources, Syntalos ensures timestamps of incoming data are aligned, so the individual pieces of
 data can be correlated without additional processing or external synchronization.
 Multiple Syntalos instances on different computers can also be started and stopped in sync over the network.
 All data and metadata generated from an experiment run is stored in a well-defined, comprehensive structure,
 making it easy to compare, pool, or share data between experimentalists with different research questions.

fedora-packages:E/E.name: E
fedora-packages:E/E.description: E is a purely equational theorem prover for full first-order logic. That means it is a program that you can stuff a mathematical specification (in first-order format) and a hypothesis into, and which will then run forever, using up all of your machines' resources. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. fedora-packages:gdouros-aroania-fonts/gd.description: Aroania is a modern recast of Victor Scholderer's "New Hellenic" font, on the basis of Verdana. In 1927, Victor Julius Scholderer (1880-1971), on behalf of the "Society for the Promotion of Greek Studies", got involved in choosing and consulting the design and production of a Greek type called "New Hellenic", cut by the Lanston Monotype Corporation. He chose the revival of a round, and almost monoline type which had first appeared in 1492 in the edition of Macrobius, ascribable to the printing shop of Giovanni Rosso (Joannes Rubeus) in Venice. The font covers the Windows Glyph List, IPA Extensions, Greek Extended, Ancient Greek Numbers, Byzantine and Ancient Greek Musical Notation, various typographic extras and several Open Type features (Case-Sensitive Forms, Small Capitals, Subscript, Superscript, Numerators, Denominators, Fractions, Old Style Figures, Historical Forms, Stylistic Alternates, Ligatures). fedora-packages:gfs-jackson-fonts/gfs-ja.name: gfs-jackson-fonts
fedora-packages:gfs-jackson-fonts/gfs-ja.summary: GFS Jackson, a majuscule Greek font family
fedora-packages:gfs-jackson-fonts/gfs-ja.description: As it is known, the Greek alphabet was used in majuscule form for over a millennium before the minuscule letters gradually replaced it until they became the official script in the 9th century A.D. Thereafter, majuscule letters were confined to sparse use as initials or elaborate titles until the Italian Renaissance. The new art of Typography, as well as the need of the humanists to mimic the ancient Greco-Roman period brought back the extensive use of the majuscule letter-forms in both Latin and Greek typography. Greek books of the time were printed using the contemporary Byzantine hand with which they combined capital letters modeled on the Roman antiquity, i.e. with thick and thin strokes and serifs. At the same time the Byzantine majuscule tradition, principally used on theological editions, remained alive until the early 19th century. GFS Jackson is an edition of the font cut, in 1788, by Joseph Jackson on commission by the Cambridge University in preparation of the edition of the Beza codex containing the New Testament from the 5th-6th century. Theodore Beza was the erudite scholar from Geneva who had given the codex as a gift to the University in 1581. It has been designed by George D. Matthiopoulos.

Quickly reload pages through your library's EZProxy for accessing paywalled journal articles and websites. 
This is a port of Tom Wambold's Chrome extension EZProxy Redirect @ https://github.com/tom5760/chrome-ezproxy 
-----------
Many universities use EZProxy to allow its students access to various online
databases. This extension adds a button to Firefox which allows for a quick way
to reload the current page through your EZProxy system.
All it does is pass the URL to your library's EZProxy login URL. For example:
 http://ieeexplore.ieee.org/

firefox-addons:2931646.name: Password Manager
firefox-addons:2931646.summary: Taskturtles presents = A simple password manager extension.
firefox-addons:2931646.description:
A simple, lightweight password manager that keeps your logins on your own computer. No account, no sync, no tracking, and nothing is ever sent anywhere.
Your logins are locked with a master password. The vault locks itself after a time you choose, and always when Firefox closes.
What it does:
Fill logins from the toolbar, or from a small icon inside the login field
Warns you before filling a login on a site it wasn't saved for, so a lookalike page can't collect your password
Offers to save a login after you sign in, including JavaScript logins and two-step sign-ins like Google and Microsoft
Custom fields: keep extra values such as PINs, security answers or message templates, and point each one at a field by clicking it on the page. This works in rich-text editors, comment boxes embedded from other sites and modern web components, and values can be several lines long
Password generator with length and character options, plus a strength meter
Copy a username or password with one click; the clipboard clears itself after 30 seconds
Organise your logins with search and color-coded cards
Backups: an encrypted export protected by your master password, and a plain-text export
Two themes, Sky and Peach
Designed for privacy-conscious users who want control without the bloat of traditional password managers.
Updating from an older version: your saved logins are kept. The first time you open the add-on you'll be asked to create a master password, and your logins are re-encrypted with it.
Requires Firefox 115 or later.

firefox-addons:625556.name: Dark Theme for YouTube™
firefox-addons:625556.summary: A Dark and Smooth Theme for YouTube™.
firefox-addons:625556.description:
Dark Theme for YouTube™ (also named, YouTube™ Dark) makes YouTube website be easier on your eyes at the night time. It adds a Dark theme to YouTube with a smooth black background.
a. Ultra lite Addon for Firefox.
b. Automatically sets a Dark theme for all YouTube pages.
c. Supports both HTML5 and Flash YouTube players.
d. Has an in-page switch button (at top right corner in YouTube website) to turn the dark theme ON or OFF.
e. Has 2 dark themes. Theme (A) uses standard CSS techniques to darken the YouTube page. Theme (B) uses CSS filters to do this job. For some unknown reasons in Firefox, theme (B) makes YouTube videos to become slow (only for latest versions of Firefox; this might be fixed in future updates). When you install the Addon, the default theme is A, which works fine with no issues. But, if you want to switch to theme B, please make sure the videos are playing normal.
Note 1: support page for this addon contains Google Analytic. Terms of service can be found at https://www.google.com/analytics/terms/ 
Note 2: in order to submit bugs, please visit addon's Homepage and fill the Bug report form.

firefox-addons:3119317.name: Haiku (BeOS) Theme for Gmail
firefox-addons:3119317.summary: Make Gmail look and work like Haiku's BeMail: a BeOS-style toolbar, Tracker message list, yellow window tabs and Haiku controls.
firefox-addons:3119317.description:
Turn Gmail into a native-looking Haiku (BeOS) mail client, modelled on Haiku's BeMail and Beam and on Haiku's interface guidelines.
• Actions in the window they act on, as in BeMail and Tracker: an open message has Reply, Reply All, Forward, Archive, Trash, Junk, Unread, Print, Previous and Next; a message list has Archive, Trash, Junk and Read/Unread for the selected messages. Each button presses Gmail's own control, so Gmail still does the work.
• Tracker-style queries: one click runs a saved search (Unread, Starred, Attachments, or your own - save any Gmail search with a name and a picture). Your queries sync through Firefox Sync.
• A Deskbar down the right edge, like Haiku's: your unread count (Primary tab, whole inbox or entire mailbox - click it to open that list), the clock, shortcuts to your Google apps, and a mini calendar. A Hide Deskbar / Show Deskbar button next to the search box puts it away.
• Made for running Gmail as an app: on Haiku the Deskbar becomes a compact app-window sidebar (right-click the Hide/Show button to choose either style anywhere). A guide on the project page covers Firefox, Chrome and Edge app windows.
• App toolbar with New, Check Mail and Google Drive, in Haiku's icons.
• Yellow window tabs over the message pane and the compose window, with a working close box.
• Tracker-style message list: 22px rows, column headers, Haiku status icons and stars.
• BeMail compose window: To and Subject labels, the Send row and formatting strip at the top, minimise and zoom boxes on the tab.
• Haiku controls throughout: bevelled push buttons, sunken text fields, radio buttons, checkboxes, menus and tab views.
• Sender pictures (a person or robot icon when Gmail has none), warning cards for spam and phishing, compact summary cards for invitations, bills and orders; a resizable folder panel; a status bar with the unread count and position. Works with Boomerang for Gmail.
• Gmail extras with no BeOS counterpart are hidden: the apps grid (the Deskbar replaces it), the side-panel promos and the Material ripples.
Everything happens in your browser. The add-on collects no data and sends nothing anywhere. Its only network requests go to Gmail itself, to read your unread counts for the Deskbar. Besides running on mail.google.com it uses the browser's add-on storage, only to keep your saved queries.
Works with Gmail's English interface and default inbox layout. Open source (MIT): https://github.com/ojdorson/haiku-theme-for-gmail 
Not affiliated with Google or Haiku, Inc. Gmail is a trademark of Google LLC. The icons are Haiku's, used under the MIT License.

apple-itunes:6449253014.description:
Desh Gujarati Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Gujarati typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Gujarati words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the language key
• Word predictions and spell-correct is available in English also
• Emoji button is available after pressing 123
Open the app and follow instructions to get your new Gujarati keyboard:
• Enable keyboard from settings
• Activate the keyboard by holding the Globe icon and selecting "Desh Gujarati Keyboard"
• Type Gujarati everywhere!
Allowing full access:
• When enabling the keyboard, you may enable "Allow Full Access"
• This allows us to access crash reports and will help us improve the stability of the app
• We respect your privacy. No personal information is collected
• A standard warning is shown when you enable any downloaded keyboard app
How to access settings:
• Tap on the ⋯ button after opening the app and tap Settings. This option will be available after keyboard is activated
• Available settings: sound on key press, vibrate on key press, emoji row, number row
Using the clipboard:
• The clipboard lets you save text that you frequently use and paste them easily
• After you copy any text, it can be viewed from the clipboard by tapping on "Paste copied text". You can use the Pin button to save it permanently
• To show copied text automatically when clipboard is opened, you can change the "Paste from Other Apps" setting to "Allow"
Using stickers to make your chats more fun:
• Open the stickers page by clicking on the sticker icon on the keyboard. Click on any sticker you like to copy it
• Navigate back to your chat app and use your phone's Paste option in the message box
• The sticker will be pasted in the chat. Note that animations are currently sent as GIFs due to technical limitations
Do share your feedback and help us improve Desh Gujarati Keyboard. And don't forget to leave a review if you like it.

fdroid:com.ventouxlabs.netlens.description:
NetLens is a comprehensive network diagnostics toolkit for Android. Inspect, diagnose, and monitor your network from a single app — no ads, no tracking, open source under AGPL-3.0.
 Network Info 
- IP Info — look up your public IP address and geolocation
- WHOIS — query domain and IP ownership records
 Connectivity 
- Ping — test latency and reachability with single or continuous mode
- DNS Lookup — query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, and other record types
- Traceroute — trace the full network path to any host
- Speed Test — measure download, upload, and latency
 Discovery 
- LAN Scan — discover devices on your local network with MAC vendor identification
- Devices — a persistent inventory of devices you have seen, with your own names, tags, and notes
- mDNS Browser — find Bonjour and .local services on the network
- Port Scanner — scan for open TCP ports on any target
- Wi-Fi Analyzer — nearby networks, signal strength, and channel usage
 Security & Web 
- Wi-Fi Audit — check the network you join for weak ciphers and WPS
- VPN Status and DNS Leak Test — see whether your traffic escapes the tunnel
- TLS Inspector — inspect SSL/TLS certificates and cipher suites
- HTTP Tester — send custom HTTP requests and inspect responses
 Tools 
- Wake-on-LAN — send magic packets to wake network devices
- Endpoint Monitor — track uptime and latency of HTTP endpoints over time
- Network Log — view connection history and network events
- History — browse past scan results with search and filtering
 Home Screen Widget 
Configurable widget for at-a-glance network status right on your home screen.
 Built with 
Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and modern Android architecture. Requires Android 10+.
 Pro 
Optional Pro unlocks extras such as background watching of your home network, which notifies you when a new device joins, and sharing results. The open-source FOSS build, which you compile from source, has every feature unlocked.
 Privacy 
No accounts, analytics, or ads. Some tools send your public IP, or an address you look up, to third-party services listed in the privacy policy.
 Open Source 
Licensed under AGPL-3.0. Source code available on GitHub.
